list: The official 55 trophies, as published for PlayStation 5 on 18 November 2026. Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words. Rarity is Exophase's share of tracked players, read 20 November 2026. Difficulty and time are this guide's estimates, not official figures.
sources_note: Every guide below is written in this guide's own words. Each one names the published guides it draws on: PowerPyx, Push Square, KeenGamer, Exophase, PSNProfiles, GTADB, Sixshore, GameMapa, Vice City Hustle, GameSpot, GameRant, DamnModz, GTASpotter and BoostingFactory. A video link is listed only where a real walkthrough video was verified; never guess a video URL.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no online trophy and no DLC trophy, so everything happens in single-player. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and the leftover miscellaneous trophies.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1-5) and grab the Chapter 1 meditation on the way.
Work the 100% Completion checklist until A Long Road pops.

The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 are done.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the whole point of Phase 2. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than it sounds: it is closer to 60% true completion. Most side quests are not needed and collectibles are only partly needed, but every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest is required, plus 70 of the 80 challenges. The 100% Checklist tab in this guide lists the big blocks.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish the story, then open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Clear every robbery: all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults.
Finish all 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting range golds and all drone races.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans and 100 flamingos.
The gold pops the moment the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida count, so pick the quickest kind and repeat the pattern. PowerPyx counts 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-bridge flights are the fastest to chain. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so this trophy pops on the way there. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Pick under-bridge flights: they are the quickest stunt type to repeat.
Work through bridges along the coast and rivers; each completed stunt stays marked on the map.
Mix in stunt jumps and base jumps when they are on your route.
The silver pops at 250; keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Do one of each. You will meet most of them naturally through the story and the other trophies; check Progress, Activities to see which types you still owe. Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the rest.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTADB — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies & Platinum Guide

steps: Open Progress, Activities and note which of the 9 types are still at zero.
Fish once, hunt once, play one hole of golf, try a shooting range.
Shoot hoops, play pool, finish one arcade game, win any race, do any stunt.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is ticked off.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Two ranges, 12 challenges, 42 gold medals. Griffin Shooting Range in north-west Vice City has 6 challenges with 3 medals each; Rodgers Ranch near Port Gellhorn has 6 challenges with 4 medals each. At each range, talk to the clerk and buy a Waiver Pass for $5 first, then the challenges appear on the map. Griffin's courses make you move through them while shooting; Rodgers Ranch is stationary scoring. Gold is the top medal in every challenge, and all 42 are also needed for 100%.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Shooting Range Gold Medal Challenges
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Go to Griffin Shooting Range (north-west Vice City) and buy the $5 Waiver Pass from the clerk.
Gold all 6 Griffin challenges, 3 medals each.
Go to Rodgers Ranch (north-east Port Gellhorn), buy its Waiver Pass, gold all 6 challenges, 4 medals each.
Track progress under Progress, Activities, Shooting Ranges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations with 42 races between them, and you need a win at every location. The races are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so treat this as a checklist job rather than a one-off: work through the locations one by one and tick them off on the map.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTADB — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies & Platinum Guide

steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location on the map (they appear as you unfog areas).
Win a race at that location; repeat until every location has a win.
All 14 locations are needed, and the 100% checklist wants every race too.

trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races: car races, race challenges and drone races all count toward the 20, as long as each race is a different one. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, so there is plenty of choice. Pick short, easy races first and do not repeat the same one expecting it to count twice.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Open the map and filter for races; there are 40 unique race locations.
Win a race, then move to a different location — repeats do not count.
Keep a count; the trophy pops on the 20th different win.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is introduced in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui. Some time after that he texts you a fishing location, marked with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTADB — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies & Platinum Guide

steps: Play the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui to meet Cal.
Wait for Cal's text with the fishing location (purple map icon).
Go there, take his fishing challenge and beat him.

trophies.guide: There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. To complete one you must finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: From Chapter 1, use the TV at home: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind.
Play through every level of the game you picked.
The trophy pops when you reach the end of the game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and then texts her home address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: In Chapter 3, play as Lucia until Andy calls and texts her address.
Go to Belville and start the Cellerica questline.
Finish all 5 quests; the trophy pops after Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's line starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams. He calls, then his shop is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving: purple chest icons mark shipwrecks, you dive with a metal detector and bring the treasure back. Seven shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3; as Jason you can speed his return by calling Brian. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: After Island Dreams (Chapter 1), answer Kenton's call and visit his shop in Key Lento.
Dive the marked shipwrecks and bring each treasure back to Kenton.
After the first set he calls again with more locations; clear all 7 shipwrecks.
If Kenton goes quiet, keep playing the story; he returns in Chapters 2-3.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's line opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), go to the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County.
Work through Billy's 5 quests in order.
The trophy pops after Hometown Heroes.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain stranger questlines count: PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove line), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and his deliveries). Many other optional lines do not count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are not strangers for this trophy. More qualifying strangers are still being found, so check the trophy tracker in the trophy list as you go. Everything is still available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Finish Kirk's Skunk Ape line (Search for the Skunk Ape, Tree Effigies, Mr. Mangrove).
Finish Kyle's line at McKittrick Farm.
Finish Yago's racing line and Pilot Pete's delivery line.
Check the trophy tracker; keep going until 8 strands are done.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. He marks some cars in fixed spots; the rest you can steal off the street. Sports cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Delivering in good condition pays more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTADB — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies & Platinum Guide

steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to get the Key Cloner.
Take Randy's list of 16 sports cars; the first, the Zorrusso, is delivered in the mission.
Steal the cars he marks, or any matching car off the street, and deliver them to his garage.
The trophy pops after the 16th delivery.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's line is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City; destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are gone, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

steps: In Chapter 3, play as Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty.
Follow the purple markers to the Synthetic Labs and destroy them.
Finish Take Out Kitty Litter, then do Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditations across 10 spots, and most spots count twice — once with Jason, once with Lucia. Only 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, but the trophy wants all 18. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation, on the balcony at Jason's house, only happens in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and Accept. It is not yet confirmed whether that balcony meditation is required for the trophy, so do it anyway — it costs a minute and protects you. The final spot, Ascent Mountain, only appears on the map after the other nine are done. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Meditation Spot Locations
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: CHAPTER 1 — after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and Accept the meditation.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2) you can play both characters: meditate at each of the 9 marked spots with Jason and with Lucia.
The spots: Smooth Sand (Mariana), Swamp, Worn Stone and Red Rocks (Kelly County), Water Wheel, Jutting Cliff, Waterfall (Lummox), Seaside (Leonard).
Once the other nine are done, the final spot appears: Ascent Mountain, at the peak of Mount Kalaga. Meditate there to finish 18/18.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's line is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Bret marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. There are 15 Target Decks in total and all of them are needed for 100%, so this trophy comes naturally on the way. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTADB — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies & Platinum Guide

steps: After Coffee Break, play as Jason and answer Bret's text.
Do Veteran Hunted in Lummox County to get the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle.
Follow Bret's purple hunting markers and bring him the animals he asks for.
Keep clearing Target Decks; the trophy pops on the unique hunt.

trophies.guide: There are 18 collectible card sets scattered across Leonida, and any 3 complete sets unlock the trophy. The 100% checklist asks for 15 sets, so this trophy pops early on the way there. Cards are found in the open world; use the map's Exploration filter and the collectible guides to sweep one region at a time rather than wandering.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Pick one region and collect every card there before moving on.
Complete any 3 full sets; the trophy pops on the third set.
Keep going to 15 sets for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are objects in the world you scan by holding Up and then R1 with the WAiNK app open. There are far more than 100: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher Tags, and any mix counts. Scan everything new as you travel during the story and you will be most of the way there before the cleanup phase. The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) whenever you pass a landmark, sculpture or curiosity.
Hold R1 to scan it; scanned spots stay logged.
Any 100 scans count; the trophy pops at 100.

trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10, and only 50 are needed for this trophy. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there. View and track them under Progress, Challenges. Most complete themselves while you work on other trophies; once you are nearly done, open the list and pick the easiest unfinished ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

steps: Play normally; challenges tick off while you chase other trophies.
Open Progress, Challenges to see what is left.
Pick the 50 easiest; skip the hardest, since only 50 are needed (70 for 100%).

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together. Call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), then cause chaos until you hit 4 stars and escape the red heat zone — the trophy pops when you drive out of it, not when you leave the flashing search area. Easiest escape: a fast sports bike, cutting through traffic, or the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vault robberies always bring a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTADB — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies & Platinum Guide

steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle).
Cause chaos until you reach a 4-star wanted level.
Escape on a fast bike, or through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia.
The trophy pops once you are out of the red heat zone.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, call your partner and hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while staying wanted the whole time. Keep the red and blue flashing wanted level — do not lose it and do not let it cool off. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop, so if it does not appear, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3: loot a couple of items in each, and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle).
Get a wanted level, then rob a shop (green icon) without losing it.
Rob a second and a third shop back-to-back, staying wanted throughout.
Wait ~30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if nothing pops, hit a fourth.

trophies.guide: Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch. The fastest way to 100 is the WAiNK app: stand on a busy road, hold Up to open it, look at passing vehicles and hold R1 to scan them. Scanning is enough — you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base model vehicles scanned, so this trophy pops on the way. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTADB — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies & Platinum Guide

steps: Stand on a busy road with the WAiNK app ready (hold Up).
Scan every new vehicle that passes (hold R1).
The trophy pops at 100 discovered; keep scanning to 200 for 100%.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm. It slows time, highlights weak spots and drains the purple focus bar, so it only lasts a few seconds. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a shower at home, and take Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch it. Then line up 5 enemies — gang members at a gang operation work well — and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Wear body armor so you can step out of cover. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels and grows as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and land headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

steps: Buff focus with food or a shower, and take Adrenaline before the fight.
Find 5 grouped enemies, such as criminals at a gang operation.
Aim, trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3) and drop all 5 with an assault rifle in one use.
If you run out of time, level up Focus first (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing).

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and enter through the door. Go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Go to VCIA and head for the plane docked at departure terminals E3/E4.
Enter through the stairs by the boarding bridge and get into the cockpit.
Reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport.
The trophy pops shortly after you are clear.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank, a Rhino, from Mile Zero Air Station — the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in south-west Mariana County.
Enter the base through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Get into a Rhino tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Go in through the back door with the Snap Gun — do not kick the door, or the alarm goes off. Inside, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Pick a jewelry store (green icon), such as Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds.
Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, never by kicking it.
Find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe and leave unseen.

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress. It teaches the method: tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry a briefcase in and open the vault, then slip in while it is open and rob it. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hold Right to hand off a bag. Afterwards, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (after his earlier payday loan quests), marking vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch cars to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs; 5 are enough here, but 100% wants all 8, and a single vault can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4; the first vault is part of the mission.
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani ($10,000) to mark the next vans.
Tail each van to its bank, enter while the vault is open, and rob it with your partner.
Escape the 4-star heat on a motorcycle, then switch vehicles. Repeat to 5 vaults.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission that opens bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is: robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank. It also pops earlier on its own: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks. Block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTADB — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies & Platinum Guide

steps: Easiest: do That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4 — the vault robbery counts.
Or, earlier: find an armored truck near a bank in Vice City.
Block it, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open.
Escape the red heat radius; the trophy pops once you are clear.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that is still black fog until the entire map is visible. Do it after the story, when you can fly freely and every region is open.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Wait until after the story, when the whole map is open.
Take a plane and fly a grid over every fogged area.
The trophy pops once no black fog is left on the map.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations in total. For this trophy you only need one operation per gang, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it pops on the way. Operations appear as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs — scroll over a gang to see how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Rob any illegal operation (yellow icon) to start; check Progress, Gangs for which gangs are still at zero.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Keep going to all 39 operations for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Hotel on Ocean Beach. Walk past the pool to the rooftop access door, take the elevator up to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, and buy the $10 Apple Martini. Drink it while standing by the bar, looking out over the ocean, and the trophy pops. It is a nod to the opening of GTA: Vice City, where Tommy Vercetti's hotel stood on the same strip.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: DamnModz — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List

steps: Go to the Ocean View Hotel on Ocean Beach.
Walk past the pool, take the rooftop access door and ride the elevator up.
Buy the $10 Apple Martini at the rooftop bar and drink it by the railing.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A callback to GTA III's Capital Autos. After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS gives you the Key Cloner, go to the Sunrise Autos showroom in south Vice City, near Peacock Bay. Inside is a blue Bravado Banshee convertible with white racing stripes. Use the Key Cloner to get in, then drive forward straight through the big glass showroom window. The pop is slightly delayed and only this specific blue Banshee counts — no other car works.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTADB — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies & Platinum Guide

steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to get the Key Cloner.
Go to the Sunrise Autos showroom in south Vice City and find the blue Banshee.
Use the Key Cloner to get in, then drive straight through the showroom window.
Drive a little further down the street; the trophy pops with a short delay.

video.label: Video: the blue Banshee showroom run (PowerPyx)

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This is not about bowling a frame — it is a robbery. Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is one of the gang operations, and you first go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside you must steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. If you miss one during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for the rest — nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTAViceCityHub — GTA 6 Achievements

steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation.
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (first visited in Hit Kingpin Bowling, Chapter 2).
Steal the luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball shotgun (north-east corner) and the safe (north-east hallway).
Escape the police; the trophy pops once you are clear.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check Strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, select a character, scroll to Strength (heart icon). Work out at a fitness club — buy a membership, and always bring your partner along (hold Right, press Triangle): while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon). You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

steps: After Coffee Break, buy a fitness club membership.
Always work out with your partner along (hold Right, press Triangle) so both train at once.
Check Strength for each character under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia.
The trophy pops when both characters are at maximum Strength.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On) and a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Stealthy finishes, clean escapes and destroying evidence push you toward Professional; incapacitating without killing is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass killing is Psycho; and keep going and you hit Irredeemable, which is permanent — avoid that one, since cops get far more aggressive. This pops passively while you do every other trophy; if it is your last one left, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

steps: Turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications.
Play normally; robberies, fights and escapes all count toward 500.
Check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
If it is your last trophy, farm the remaining actions in free-roam.

trophies.guide: HONESTLY UNKNOWN — no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks as of 20 November 2026. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown and believes it may be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue; KeenGamer and Push Square also list the method as unconfirmed. Do not waste time guessing: this guide will mark it confirmed the moment two independent guides agree. Until then, keep playing the story — several guides note the vague hidden trophies tend to pop during campaign moments.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: No confirmed method yet — check back; this entry updates when two guides agree.
Lead only, unconfirmed: PowerPyx believes it may relate to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
Do not grind anything for this trophy until a method is confirmed.

trophies.guide: Get abducted by a UFO. After Chapter 1, go alone — no partner — to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, east of Port Gellhorn, after 2:00 AM. Look for a parked car with its lights flashing. If it is not there, drive away and come back; the spawn is partly random. Follow the trail from the car into the woods toward the blue light. The UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, agree to help, and walk back to her car. The UFO comes back and takes you instead. You wake up three in-game days later and the trophy pops. The encounter is recorded on video by PowerPyx and written up by GameSpot and GameRant.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: GameSpot — GTA 6 Has Aliens, And Here's How To Find Them
PowerPyx — GTA 6 UFO Aliens Easter Egg Location
GameRant — UFO Location in GTA 6

steps: After Chapter 1, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2:00 AM.
Look for the parked car with flashing lights; if it is missing, leave and return.
Follow the trail into the woods toward the blue light.
Talk to the woman the UFO drops and agree to help her.
Walk back to her car; the UFO abducts you and the trophy pops.

video.label: Video: the Kelly County UFO abduction (PowerPyx)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: LEAD ONLY, NOT CONFIRMED — no guide has nailed this one down yet as of 20 November 2026. PowerPyx believes it is about kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, and another guide reads that as knocking pedestrians off a bike. KeenGamer still lists the precise method as being confirmed. The honest plan: on a motorcycle, ride through a crowd and use melee kicks (the drive-by melee attack) to knock people down, and watch whether the trophy pops. Do not grind it blind for hours — treat it as a try-it-and-see trophy and check back for a confirmed method.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTAViceCityHub — GTA 6 Achievements

steps: Get a motorcycle and ride through a busy area.
Use the melee drive-by kick to knock people down from the bike.
Repeat with different crowds; the exact count is unconfirmed, so stop and check back if it does not pop.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and payday loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally while you clear the vaults for Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and payday loans to collect marked bills.
Bring the bills to a fence (Yasmani pays best) until $250,000 is laundered in total.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops — the count is cumulative and covers everything you buy all game. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money, since they are the most expensive. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and more, so you will likely pop this naturally while gearing up; if it is still short at the end, buy the most expensive gun mods you have not bought yet.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Buy guns, car mods and tattoos as you play; all spending counts.
Check your total by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
If short at the end, buy the priciest gun mods left.

trophies.guide: There are 8 purchasable garages and 4 story-related ones; only the 8 purchasable ones count, costing $160,000 in total. Garages unlock for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. Buy all 8 through the app. The fastest money comes from robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. Garages also add parking spots, which you need for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTADB — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies & Platinum Guide

steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Earn $160,000 (robberies pay best).
Buy all 8 garages through the phone app.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds parking spots to register more vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage choose Respray and Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can register cars with standard trackers, and at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so pick cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep it cheap.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to get the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first so you have parking spots to register into.
Steal cheap cars or bikes and drive them to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Choose Respray and Register; repeat until 10 vehicles are registered.
